> Mountain View, California 94043, USA (Exact street names may vary slightly depending on the provider.) --- ### 2️⃣ Reverse‑geocoding via the Google Maps Geocoding API If you’re writing code and want to convert the numeric lat/long into a full formatted address, here’s the standard HTTP GET pattern: ``` https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json? latlng={LATITUDE},{LONGITUDE} &key={YOUR_API_KEY} ``` #### Example Request ```http GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=AIzaSyDxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` *(Replace `AIzaSy...` with your own key.)* #### Sample Response (truncated) ```json { "results" : [ { "address_components": [...], "formatted_address":"1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA", "geometry":{ "location":{"lat":37.4224764,"lng":-122.0842499}, ... }, "place_id":"ChIJj61dQgK6j4ARw5Z7Yf8tXxE", "types":["establishment","point_of_interest"] } ], "status":"OK" } ``` That `formatted_address` field gives you the canonical postal address.
